title: nbn service fault - Lochinvar South, NSW
current_summary: A fault on the nbn access network is affecting one Lightning IP service in Lochinvar South, NSW. It was reported at 6:20 pm AEDT on 13 November 2026, and no restoration estimate has been provided yet.
